events.title: Swiss Market Ends Flat After Choppy Session
events.description: Switzerland's benchmark index SMI slipped into negative territory Tuesday morning after a brief spell above the flat line, and despite climbing higher around late afternoon, ended the session roughly flat.

events.title: European Stocks Close Weak As Mood Turns Cautious
events.description: European stocks closed on a weak note on Tuesday as uncertainty about AI trade and fears of tariff hikes by the U.S. rendered the mood cautious. A sell-off in technology sector on Wall Street weighed as well.

events.title: AI Sector Retreat Triggers Broader Tech Decline
events.description: A sharp reversal in technology stocks drove market declines Tuesday, with Nvidia down 8% and semiconductor peers falling sharply. Consumer confidence jumped unexpectedly to 103.3 in November, providing some support to broader indices.

events.title: Dollar Tree Q3 EPS, Comps Rise; Sees Comps Growth In Q4; Lifts FY26 Outlook; Stock Gains
events.description: Shares of Dollar Tree Inc. were gaining around 8 percent in the pre-market activity on Nasdaq, after the discount retailer on Tuesday reported higher third-quarter earnings per share and comparable sales. Further, the firm issued positive fourth-quarter comparable store sales outlook and raised fiscal 2026 earnings view on strong demand.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Look Headed For Weak Start
events.description:
Weak Canadian and U.S. futures and lower precious metals prices point to a weak start on Bay Street Tuesday morning.

The buoyancy over the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Chief Executive Office of NVIDI appears to have subsided.

events.title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Raises FY26 View After Strong Q3; Stock Up 18%
events.description: Shares of Dick's Sporting Goods Inc. were climbing around 18 percent in pre-market activity on the NYSE after the sports retailer on Tuesday raised fiscal 2026 outlook, after reporting significant growth in third-quarter profit and net sales.

events.title: Yen Falls Amid Global AI Sector Revival
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, amid revived enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade.

events.title: FTSE 100 Modestly Lower As Mining Stocks Shed Ground
events.description: The U.K. stock market's benchmark index FTSE 100 was down in negative territory around late morning on Tuesday, weighed down to a large extent by sharp losses in the mining sector due to weak metals prices. Banks and real estate stocks too shed notable ground.

events.title: CAC 40 Roughly Flat As Stocks Turn In Mixed Performance
events.description: French stocks turned in a mixed performance on Tuesday as investors made cautious moves and looked for directional clues. The market had moved up sharply on Monday, as global stocks, led by technology shares, rallied after NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as the company's CEO.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: DAX Down Nearly 1% In Cautious Trade
events.description: A day after moving up sharply amid renewed optimism about AI trade following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia, German stocks turned weak with investors making cautious moves, looking for fresh directional clues.

events.title: German Ifo Business Confidence Strongest Since 2023
events.description: German business sentiment improved to the highest level in more than three years in November as assessment of current situation and expectations brightened, monthly survey data from the ifo Institute showed Tuesday. events.title: Gold Edges Lower As Traders Await US Inflation Data
events.description: Gold prices traded lower on Tuesday after rebounding from a 14-month low in the previous session.
